review.notes: Independent review after FIX-PKG-EllipticKTheory~adv. The sole open finding of REV-PKG-EllipticKTheory~adv (README 7.7, Bloch normalisation) is closed: Bloch, ICM Helsinki 1978, vol. 2, p. 514 (official IMU PDF, SHA-256 dc99c900...) was read; it builds the integral element {rho,f_x}^N times corrections {f_i,c_i} (function first) in the tame kernel, with rho and f_x of exactly the divisors of 7.5-7.6, in characteristic zero and with no division by N, so C*blochClass = pi_C(S^ICM) is the right comparison. Fixed in place: (1) an upward ask: Scope and Downstream consumers claimed that MotivicEtaleKTheory and K2SymbolsBrauer consume 5.5, which would be a cycle; their packages list this roadmap only as a consumer. Removed, and the neighbouring MotivicEtaleKTheory 3.4 statements are named as a boundary. (2) A missing supplier: ArithmeticKTheory, cited as N.3 for finite generation of K-groups of curves over finite fields, excludes curves over finite fields. Added the owned target curveFiniteGeneration to 5.5 (K-book IV.6.9, p. 325; Grayson 1982; Harder 1977; ArithmeticKTheory 3.2's Dedekind criterion), and repointed tameKernel_finite and harder. (3) Stale stage ids: every K2SymbolsBrauer T.2-T.5, KTheoryLowDegrees U.3/U.4/Z.5/Z.6, ArithmeticKTheory N.1-N.3 and MotivicEtaleKTheory M.4-M.7 citation now names the supplier package section. Wrong sections were also fixed: KTheoryFiniteLocalFields 1.7-1.9, the K3BlochGroups 2.2 claim, SchemeKTheoryOperations 7.2 vs 2.5, ProfiniteCohomology for H^1(Zhat,M), ModularCurves 2B-2D, AlgebraicCurves 12B, the JacobianChallenge A/B hypotheses, DWP.0 0.2 and AGD D7. (4) Current upstream SchemeAndStackFoundations is cited for the Weil bound (5.11) and smooth-implies-regular (4.13), and JacobianChallenge Layer D for the Picard obstruction. (5) Supplier duplicates removed: 2.1/2.6 now consume KTheoryLowDegrees 12.2 (rank-determinant ring isomorphism and class formulas), 3.1/3.3/3.6 consume SchemeKTheoryOperations 3.7 (one-dimensional localisation, divisor boundary, finite pushforward), and 5.4 consumes SchemeKTheoryOperations 5.5 (projective line), each keeping only its curve-specific content. (6) Generality: Layer 6 model theory is stated to hold over S-integers of global function fields. (7) Scholl 1.1.2 locator p. 3. Lean: merged the three tameValue examples into two, removed the Finsupp-over-Q arithmetic example and the example that rested on the sorry'd Hom.subsingleton, and fixed a stale docstring citation. lean-check exits 0 with 14 declaration-uses-sorry warnings only; 435 lines; check_sorry_data and intake check-files report 0 problems. 15 random locators checked against sources; 14 were correct and the other is fixed. Adversarial pass in the report. Residual notes for the maintainer, which do not block the PR: register the roadmap in the supplier order after WeightsInEtaleCohomology; the 5.5/MotivicEtaleKTheory 3.4 overlap; stale ids in other packages.
